blocks.text: Choosing a home is rarely just about finding the right space. It is also about the neighborhood, the conveniences nearby and the kind of everyday life that comes with the address. For some, that means having places to unwind after a busy day. For others, it is being close to shopping, dining and recreation, or having access to spaces where business and community life can grow. At Cebu’s South Road Properties (SRP), Sanremo Oasis by Filinvest Land, Inc. brings these considerations together within City di Mare, a master-planned community that combines residential living with commercial and lifestyle destinations.
